releases.name: v2.28
releases.body:
本版把 27B-KV-01 的配置 C 与配置 D 从「Prefill 优先 / Decode 优先」改述为**两条解码路线**，区别在解码主力放在哪张卡上。

- **配置 C · 395 解码**：RTX 3080 不装草稿头，算力全部给 Prefill，KV 写回 AI Max+ 395，解码由 395 承担（该侧带 DFlash 头单流 38.75 tok/s、持全量 KV 池）。Prefill 因此是本节最高的 1194.4–1210.6 tok/s。
- **配置 D · 3080 解码**：DFlash 草稿头装到 3080 上，由 3080 自己解码（该卡带头单流实测自然语言 42.7 tok/s、代码 67.4 tok/s，是 395 带同一个头的 2.2–2.3 倍），聚合 Decode 从 63.84 抬到 116.3 tok/s。
- **配置 D 的 Prefill 为什么低约一成**：不只是「腾显存」，而是 3080 的算力和显存被解码分走一大块——草稿头权重 1080 MiB、验证批另需约 500 MiB 计算缓冲，ctx8192 下 ubatch 从 1024 压到 512、slot 从 2 个减到 1 个，每步验证批矩阵乘 4 token 批 +21 ms、8 token 批 +49 ms。Prefill 于是从 1210.6 掉到 1077–1090 tok/s。
- 全库把「395 不参与任何计算」改为准确表述「395 不参与 Prefill 稠密计算」，解码归属改由两条路线说明；涉及双语首页、双语 27B 详档、时间线 v2.8 行与末尾口径条。

本版没有做任何新测量，所有数值沿用既有实测记录；`data/`、`assets/` 下文件未改动。

releases.name: v2.26 - ORNITH-PD-02 fused DFlash speculative decode over PD
releases.body:
This release adds the second Ornith experiment, which had never been filed: **ORNITH-PD-02**.

## What is new

On top of the independent PD of ORNITH-PD-01 (RTX 3080 does all Prefill, AI Max+ 395 does all Decode), the 395 side now runs fused DFlash speculative decode (`--spec-type draft-dflash`, draft length n_max 6) and its six slots share one unified KV pool (`--kv-unified`).

Measured on a single-stream 1000 in / 128 out workload:

| Configuration | Prefill (tok/s) | Single-stream Decode (tok/s) | Draft acceptance |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Fused recipe, Prefill batch 4096 | 4173.47 | 114.86 | 107/114 (93.86%) |
| Fused recipe, batch 8196, context 128K | 4123.15 | 114.42 | not recorded |
| Same recipe, a prompt the draft head could not predict | 3665.3 | 37.2 | 9.4% |

All three endpoints answered HTTP 200 with no OOM or crash; the RTX 3080 held 18661/20480 MiB and the 395 Vulkan side about 22678/65536 MiB. The Decode figure tracks draft acceptance: back at 93.86% it is 3.09x the 37.2 result, so the acceptance rate must always be quoted with it.

Also filled in: the 1000-input Prefill figures of ORNITH-PD-01, C1 4017.46 to C6 3943.88, which were already in the CSV and the record but had not been shown on the homepage. On that same workload the fused recipe sits 3.88% above the C1 figure.

## Boundaries kept

- The two Ornith experiments use different workloads: ORNITH-PD-01 is a C1-C6 concurrency matrix, ORNITH-PD-02 is a single stream. They are not merged into one ranking.
- Nothing derived from total wall-clock time was restored; the aggregate Decode column removed in v2.12 stays removed and `e2e_aggregate_primary_tok_s` stays NA.
- No new measurement was taken for this release. Every figure comes verbatim from the original experiment records `r379_summary.md` and `r382_ctx_prefill.md`.

## Files

New bilingual record `results/ornith-1.5-35b-a3b-fused-dflash-pd.md` (and `.zh-CN.md`) with the verbatim parameters of the 8080 / 8081 / 8082 processes; two rows appended to `data/ornith35a3b-local-results.csv` and one row to `data/experiment-index.csv`, with all existing rows unchanged.

releases.name: v2.25 - model and quantization in every experiment heading
releases.body:
## 中文

这一版只改标识，不改数据：每个实验的标题现在直接写出被测模型与权重量化，读者不用打开表格就知道数据对应什么。

- 双语首页的 9 个实验标题统一为「实验编号 · 模型 · 权重量化 · 实验用途」。例如 `27B-LONG-01 · Qwen3.8-27B · UD-IQ3_XXS · 模型分层装`、`ORNITH-PD-01 · Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B · IQ4_XS · MoE 的 PD 压测`。
- 标题下的配置行补齐模型与量化，并把**权重量化**和 **KV 缓存量化**分开写（27B 服务态与 Flash 切层的 KV 都是 `q4_0`）；Ornith 那项同时标明 `IQ4_XS` 主模型与 `Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-DFlash-Q4_K_M` 草稿头。
- 量化格式一律照抄 `data/` 里 CSV 的 `quantization` 字段与 `results/` 详档原文，不做归一化改写。
- 9B 那一档的模型名改为 **Ornith 9B**。此前写的「Ornith-1.5-9B」在详档、CSV 和全部原始记录里都查不到依据（那个 1.5 是从 Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B 类推来的）；详档 `results/v1.0-independent-pd.md` 与 `results/v2.4-fused-layer-pipeline.md` 只记「9B, Q6_K」，配置行现已注明这一点。
- 六格实验矩阵的每一格补上该格用的模型与权重量化；「详档与数据」目录表第二列由「加速卡」改为「模型 · 权重量化 · 加速卡」，表格仍是 5 列。

没有新测量，没有改动任何实验数值。门禁 10 项全部通过：以远端 v2.24 为基线，双语首页数值多重集无一丢失（唯一减少的两个 token 是版本号 `2.24` 与被替换掉的 v2.24 版本说明句里的 `5`，同一表述仍在时间线 v2.24 行），17 个链接目标全在，所有表格不超过 5 列，`results`/`data`/`assets` 共 22 个文件与 v2.24 逐字节相同，与基线不同的文件恰好只有本次发布的这 5 个。

## English

This release changes labels only, not data: every experiment heading now names the model under test and its weight quantization, so a reader knows what a table measures before opening it.

- All 9 experiment headings on both homepages follow "experiment ID · model · weight quantization · purpose", for example `27B-LONG-01 · Qwen3.8-27B · UD-IQ3_XXS · model split across layers` and `ORNITH-PD-01 · Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B · IQ4_XS · MoE PD stress test`.
- The configuration line under each heading now carries the model and quantization, keeping **weight quantization** separate from **KV-cache quantization** (`q4_0` for the 27B serving runs and the Flash layer split). The Ornith entry names both its `IQ4_XS` main model and its `Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-DFlash-Q4_K_M` draft head.
- Quantization strings are copied verbatim from the `quantization` column in `data/` and from the records under `results/`, with no normalization.
- The 9B tier's model is now **Ornith 9B**. The earlier "Ornith-1.5-9B" has no support in the records, the CSV files, or any raw log; that 1.5 was carried over from Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B. `results/v1.0-independent-pd.md` and `results/v2.4-fused-layer-pipeline.md` label the tier only as "9B, Q6_K", and the configuration line now says so.
- Every cell of the six-cell matrix now states its model and weight quantization, and the second column of "Detailed Reports and Data" changed from "Accelerator" to "Model · weight quantization · accelerator". The table is still 5 columns.

No new measurements and no experimental value changed. All 10 gate checks passed against remote v2.24: no numeric token lost from either homepage (the only two that drop are the version token `2.24` and the `5` inside the replaced v2.24 version note, whose statement still exists in the v2.24 timeline row), all 17 link targets intact, every table at most 5 columns, all 22 files under `results`/`data`/`assets` byte-identical to v2.24, and exactly the 5 published files differ from the baseline.

releases.name: v2.24
releases.body:
## v2.24 — 原理在前、数据已验证、表格可读

- 首页章节顺序改为：这套方案怎么工作 → 两条加速卡路线与六类实验 → 实验结果：全部实测并验证 → 时间线 → 怎么读这些数据 → 后续规划 → 详档与数据。中英文同步。
- 每一处数据都按「已实测并验证」陈述：删去六格矩阵的进度行和路线表「这条线缺什么」一行，矩阵第三列改为「已验证到哪一步」；原「没有对照的实验」一组改为服务能力实验组，每项写它验证了什么；要补的对照集中写进后续规划 v3.0。
- 原 8 列宽表拆成每个实验一个不超过 5 列的小表（行是配置、列是指标），GitHub 上可正常阅读。
- 架构图 `assets/base-architecture.png` / `assets/base-architecture.zh-CN.png` 重绘为 1600×1100 纵向大字号布局；绘图脚本 `make_base_architecture.py` 入库。
- 没有新测量，没有改动任何一个数值。

English: the principle and architecture now come before any data; every figure is stated as measured and verified; one table per experiment with at most 5 columns; the architecture diagram is redrawn at 1600×1100 with large type; no new measurements and no numeric value changed.

releases.name: v2.23

- 核对结论：首页 27B-PD-01 里 AI Max+ 395 单机的 Prefill **207.2 tok/s** 是原始实验记录里的 C1 solo 实测（v1.0 服务态，TTFT 4825 毫秒与之自洽），不是 1207.2 的笔误；1200 以上的 Prefill 只出现在 RTX 3080 一侧。
- 首页补写 395 单机 27B Prefill 的三个口径：207.2（v1.0 服务态、开着 524 MiB 递归态检查点整拷）、307.1（关掉检查点后的 v1.1 服务态）、313.28（IQ3 `llama-bench` pp4096）；时间线 v2.6 行补入 3080 侧 1000.6 → 1210.6 的递进。

---

- Verified: the AI Max+ 395 solo Prefill of **207.2 tok/s** in the 27B-PD-01 row is the measured C1 solo result from the original log (v1.0 serving; the 4825 ms TTFT on the same row agrees with it), not a typo for 1207.2. Every Prefill above 1200 belongs to the RTX 3080 side.

releases.name: v2.20 - readable rewrite of both homepages
releases.body:
v2.20 rewrites both homepages for readability.

- Plain wording replaces stacked jargon in Chinese and English.
- Long sentences are broken into short ones with a clear subject and verb.
- Section headings were reworded; structure and ordering are unchanged.
- No new measurement, no changed value; results, data, and assets are untouched.

releases.name: v2.19 - accelerator tracks split, single-device baselines first
releases.body:
v2.19 splits the two accelerator tracks apart and puts single-device baselines first.

- New chapter "Two accelerator tracks: RTX 3060 12GB and RTX 3080 20GB" placed before the timeline. Track 1 covers v1.0-v2.4 (9B dense, 9B-PD-01 / 9B-PIPE-01 / 27B-LONG-01); track 2 covers v2.5-v2.14 (27B dense and MoE, 27B-PD-01 / 27B-KV-01 / ORNITH-PD-01 / FLASH-SPLIT-01). The two tracks are never merged into one ranking.
- New section "Single-device baselines first" ahead of every heterogeneous table: RTX 3060 card 1589.00 / 43.87 tok/s, AI Max+ 395 host 861.55 / 30.24 tok/s (serving) and 970.00 / 31.27 tok/s (llama-bench) for the 9B tier; RTX 3080 raw compute and 395 host rows for the 27B tier.
- Matched-baseline table now shows baseline and route values in separate columns; envelope table gained an accelerator column and a missing-baseline column; the six-cell matrix, route selector, and experiment registry all name their card.
- No new measurement, no changed value; the results, data, and assets directories are unchanged.

releases.name: v2.18 - experiment timeline front and center, both languages rewritten
releases.body: Homepage narrative rebuild. The experiment timeline (v1.0 to v2.17) now sits right after the base architecture and is grouped into four phases: 9B dense pipeline, 27B on the RTX 3080, MoE and single-server layer split, then governance-only releases. Wording rewritten in both Chinese and English. No new measurement, no value change; results/ and data/ untouched.

releases.name: v2.17 — Architecture-first six-experiment plan
releases.body: Moves the base architecture to the top; restores the RTX 3080/3060 six-experiment matrix for Dense and MoE fit regimes; restores the v2.1→v2.1X evolution and preserves v3.0/v4.0 planning. No benchmark source value changed.

releases.name: v2.16 — Data-first experiment overview and route selection
releases.body: Homepage now exposes matched baseline gains, no-baseline serving envelopes, direct conclusions, and a route selector. Full result matrices remain in canonical records and CSV files. Benchmark source values are unchanged.

releases.name: v2.15 — Experiment contracts and evidence boundaries
releases.body:
Reorganizes the repository around stable experiment IDs and explicit research contracts.

- One primary question, control, changed factor, decision gate, and claim boundary per experiment
- Benchmark tables removed from the homepages and retained in canonical result records
- 9B checkpoints and 27B C/D profiles no longer counted as separate experiments
- KV-only, Ornith, and Flash layer-split claims narrowed to the evidence their controls support
- Added data/experiment-index.csv for legacy-label and evidence mapping

releases.name: v2.14 — Qwen3.8-Flash Q4 Dual-Device Layer Split (r374 Final C1–C6)
releases.body: Publishes the Qwen3.8-Flash Q4 dual-device layer-split record (r374): one llama-server on the RTX 3080 (CUDA0) and AI Max+ 395 (Vulkan1), tensor split 0.38/0.62, ubatch 1024 / batch 4096, flash attention on, q4_0 KV cache, 6 slots at 131072 context. Final C1-C6 envelope (~2077 in / 256 out, temperature 0): aggregate Prefill 569.892-633.685 tok/s (peak C4), aggregate Decode 35.204-71.185 tok/s (peak C4), total throughput up to 338.270 tok/s at C4. 21/21 scored requests HTTP 200 with complete timings; warm-up excluded. New files: results/qwen3.8-flash-q4-layer-split.md (+ zh-CN), data/qwen38flash-q4-local-results.csv.
